messages:
alice: Odd one: during onboarding demo I saw two JSON objects concatenated into one `data` value after a rapid reconnect + auth refresh. node-sdk v1.4.4 sampleapp.

alice: Repro steps (loopback): start stream; backend sends `data: {...}` but without final blank-line; client triggers token refresh and reconnects within ~150ms; backend sends next event. Sometimes client parser yields a single `data` string like `{"a":1}{"b":2}` instead of two events.

alice: tcpdump excerpt (very small):
```
# conn A tail: data: {"a":1}
# no \n


# conn B head: data: {"b":2}
```

tom: thanks, saw similar in my fuzz runs. Looks like parser holds partial buffer until a blank-line; on close it didn't clear, so new bytes append. Is this only node?

rachel: not only node. Swift URLSession and Java OkHttp wrappers exhibited the same symptom when the client crashed or auth refresh happened mid-stream. Different parsers but same fundamental assumption: wait for blank-line to emit.

tom: two low-cost mitigations: (A) on transport `close`/`error` force-clear or emit a non-JSON comment `:partial-truncated` before reset; (B) treat a leading control line (`id:`/`event:`/`retry:`) on incoming bytes as implicit delimiter. Both together cover crash and ordered reconnect cases.

alice: implemented (A) in local node branch: on `req.on('close')` if `parser.buffer` non-empty -> `parser.emit('comment', ':partial-truncated')` then `parser.reset()`. That made my repro vanish locally. PR incoming.

rachel: parity concern: please land same behavior in mobile SDKs. For mobile, emitting a comment is safer because it won't break JSON-only consumers. Also add opt-in config `sse.partialHandling = "legacy|comment|drop"` default `legacy`. Recommend demos use `comment`.

tom: agree. Also add an integration test that simulates: child client writes `data: {...}` then `process.exit(1)` without CRLF, then new client immediately sends `data: {...}` and assert SDK yields two events. This caught several race regressions in CI for me.

alice: created issue DEVEX-2784: "SSE: partial buffer coalescence after quick reconnects and auth refresh" and attached a tiny repro harness. devex-bot created it for me.

infra-bot: Created issue DEVEX-2784: https://tracker.internal/DEVEX-2784

rachel: long-term: consider server-side `id` sequencing or a tiny `seq:` meta so clients can detect concatenated JSON and reject/re-fetch. But that's heavier. For now, client-side flush + docs note is the way.

tom: deployed an experimental `comment` flag to sampleapp demo builds. Also added docs blurb in docs/streaming.md: "If you hit weird merged data after crashes or auth refreshes, enable `sse.partialHandling=comment` for demos; servers should also emit final CRLF and flush. Backports to 1.3.x planned for sampleapp pins."

alice: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/955 - includes parser reset-on-close + unit+integration test. Requesting review from @tom @rachel.

rachel: LGTM, minor nit on test timeouts. Once green, we'll coordinate the mobile ports and patch releases. Thanks for quick triage. :rocket:
